patterns: APPSC asks direct single-fact items: Sendai target year (2030), Target E (2020), Bhopal gas (MIC), Operation Vanilla (Madagascar), NIDM southern campus, nodal ministry (MHA).
Statement items on DM Act 2005 NDMA powers (lays down policy, approves National Plan and ministry plans) and Yokohama 1994 / IDNDR dates recur.
Conceptual DRR items: Disaster Crunch (Pressure-and-Release) model - vulnerability rooted in socio-economic processes; post-2015 frameworks trap (Hyogo NOT one).
Classification questions ('which type of disaster is avalanche/biological flooding') and earthquake-resistant design (small, centrally located openings) appear.
App leans heavily on long match-the-list and assertion-reason items built from notes wording (Sendai priorities/targets, MHA division roles), more UPSC-style than the short APPSC items.
